texto: In the courtesy treatment (**Lei**), the imperative uses the forms of the present congiuntive, reversing the vowels with respect to the indicative present: The verbs in **-are** end in **-i**: **parlare → parli!**, **ascoltare → ascolti!**, **guardare → guardi!**.
The verbs in **-ere** and **-ire** end in **-a**: **prendere → prenda!**, **leggere → legga!**, **aprire → apra!**, **sentire → senta!**.
**dire → dica!** (* Mi dica, signore *); **fare → faccia!** (* Faccia con calma *); **venire → venga!** (* Ven avanti *); **andare → vada!** (* Vada ritto *).
In the formal imperative, the pronouns are placed **delante del verbo**: **Lo prenda dopo cena**; **Mi dica pure**.

filas: Parli più piano, per favore. (Hable más despacio, por favor.)
Prenda questa medicina dopo i pasti. (Tome este medicamento tras las comidas.)
Mi dica tutto con calma. (Dígame todo con tranquilidad.)
Venga nel mio studio. (Venga a mi consulta.)

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: professional and medical courtesy formulas

frases.it: Buongiorno, signor Conti! Si accomodi e mi dica tutto.
frases.es: ¡Buenos días, señor Conti! Tome asiento y dígame todo.
frases.en: Good morning, Mr. Conti! Take a seat and tell me everything.

frases.it: Buongiorno, dottoressa. Ho dolori articolari alle gambe da giorni.
frases.es: Buenos días, doctora. Tengo dolores articulares en las piernas desde hace días.
frases.en: Good morning, doctor. I've had joint pain in my legs for days.

frases.it: Capisco. Prenda queste compresse due volte al giorno dopo pranzo e cena.
frases.es: Entiendo. Tome estos comprimidos dos veces al día tras almuerzo y cena.
frases.en: I understand. Take these tablets twice a day after lunch and dinner.

frases.it: E devo tornare per un controllo la settimana prossima?
frases.es: ¿Y debo regresar para una revisión la semana que viene?
frases.en: And I have to go back for a review next week?

frases.it: Certamente: torni venerdì mattina e non faccia sforzi fisici pesanti.
frases.es: Desde luego: regrese el viernes por la mañana y no haga esfuerzos físicos intensos.
frases.en: Of course, come back on Friday morning and do not make intense physical efforts.
analisis: I'll be back on Friday morning.

bloques.pregunta: How is «take these tablets» said with formal courtesy treatment (Lei)?

opciones.explicacion: In verbs of the second conjugation (-ere), the formal need for courtesy ends in -a: «prenda».
It's the informal treatment of you.
It's the plural treatment addressed to you.

bloques.pregunta: What is the form of «dire» imperative courtesy for «Tell me.»?

opciones.explicacion: The verb dire takes the irregular form of courtesy «dica», with the pronoun above: «mi dica».
«Di'» is the informal form of second person singular (you).
It is the way addressed to you (voi).

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the formal form of «dire».
bloques.frase: Dottore, per favore, mi ___ che cosa devo fare per guarire.

opciones.explicacion: A respectful form of courtesy of present congiuntive / formal imperative.

bloques.pregunta: What communicative record reflects the phrase?
bloques.frase: Signora Bianchi, prenda questo sciroppo ogni otto ore.

opciones.texto: A formal and professional medical and patient registration.
opciones.explicacion: The use of «Signora Bianchi» and the form in -a «prenda» mark the treatment of courtesy «Lei».

opciones.texto: Colloquial and informal registration between two children in the school yard.
opciones.explicacion: I'd use «prendi» and formulas from you.

opciones.texto: Una advertencia desabrida sin fórmulas de respeto.
opciones.explicacion: It's a perfectly courteous medical prescription.

bloques.pregunta: What verbal form leads this respectful invitation?
bloques.frase: Venga pure nel mio studio per la visita medica.

opciones.texto: Imperativo formal de cortesía del verbo irregular «venire» (Lei venga).
opciones.explicacion: It respectfully invites the patient to access the medical consultation.

opciones.texto: Imperativo plural dirigido a un colectivo de sanitarios.

opciones.explicacion: It is a formal form of a formal present.

bloques.frase: Mi dica il suo nome per favore
bloques.explicacion: Courtesy imperative with clit pronoun above.

bloques.pregunta: How is «Speak slowly.» formal instruction formulated with «Lei»?

opciones.explicacion: In the first conjugation (-are) the need for courtesy adopts the thematic vocal «-i»: «parli».
It would be your informal imperative.
It would be the plural instruction for you.

intro: It has the formal requirement of courtesy to provide professional and medical guidance, prescriptions and instructions.
